data.title: Interview Pipeline Latency
data.description: Per-call STT -> LLM -> TTS latency and TTFB for the dograh interview agent (service.name = dograh-pipeline).

panel-1.title: Pipeline latency per call
panel-1.description: Worst single stage latency per call (trace). Total = LLM + TTS + STT.

clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT traceID AS trace_id, toDateTime(timestamp) AS call_time, round(maxIf(durationNano / 1e9, name = 'llm'), 3) AS llm_s, round(maxIf(durationNano / 1e9, name = 'tts'), 3) AS tts_s, round(maxIf(durationNano / 1e9, name = 'stt'), 3) AS stt_s, round(maxIf(durationNano / 1e9, name = 'llm') + maxIf(durationNano / 1e9, name = 'tts') + maxIf(durationNano / 1e9, name = 'stt'), 3) AS pipeline_s FROM signoz_traces.signoz_index_v2 WHERE serviceName = 'dograh-pipeline' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY traceID, call_time ORDER BY call_time DESC LIMIT 200

panel-2.title: Pipeline latency p50 / p95 (per call)
panel-2.description: Percentiles of per-call pipeline latency (LLM+TTS+STT) over time.

clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfMinute(call_time) AS t, quantile(0.5)(pipeline_s) AS p50_s, quantile(0.95)(pipeline_s) AS p95_s FROM ( SELECT traceID, toDateTime(timestamp) AS call_time, maxIf(durationNano / 1e9, name = 'llm') + maxIf(durationNano / 1e9, name = 'tts') + maxIf(durationNano / 1e9, name = 'stt') AS pipeline_s FROM signoz_traces.signoz_index_v2 WHERE serviceName = 'dograh-pipeline' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY traceID, call_time ) GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

panel-3.title: LLM TTFB (time to first token)
panel-3.description: metrics.ttfb on llm spans, in seconds.

clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfMinute(timestamp) AS t, quantile(0.5)(attributesNumber['metrics.ttfb']) AS p50_s, quantile(0.95)(attributesNumber['metrics.ttfb']) AS p95_s FROM signoz_traces.signoz_index_v2 WHERE serviceName = 'dograh-pipeline' AND name = 'llm' AND has(attributesNumber, 'metrics.ttfb') AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

panel-4.title: TTS TTFB (time to first byte)
panel-4.description: metrics.ttfb on tts spans, in seconds.

clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfMinute(timestamp) AS t, quantile(0.5)(attributesNumber['metrics.ttfb']) AS p50_s, quantile(0.95)(attributesNumber['metrics.ttfb']) AS p95_s FROM signoz_traces.signoz_index_v2 WHERE serviceName = 'dograh-pipeline' AND name = 'tts' AND has(attributesNumber, 'metrics.ttfb') AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

panel-5.title: STT TTFB (utterance processing)
panel-5.description: metrics.ttfb on stt spans, in seconds.

clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfMinute(timestamp) AS t, quantile(0.5)(attributesNumber['metrics.ttfb']) AS p50_s, quantile(0.95)(attributesNumber['metrics.ttfb']) AS p95_s FROM signoz_traces.signoz_index_v2 WHERE serviceName = 'dograh-pipeline' AND name = 'stt' AND has(attributesNumber, 'metrics.ttfb') AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

panel-6.title: Stage duration breakdown
panel-6.description: Avg and p95 duration per stage over the last 6 hours.

clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT name AS stage, count() AS calls, round(avg(durationNano / 1e9), 3) AS avg_s, round(quantile(0.95)(durationNano / 1e9), 3) AS p95_s FROM signoz_traces.signoz_index_v2 WHERE serviceName = 'dograh-pipeline' AND name IN ('llm', 'tts', 'stt') AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR GROUP BY stage ORDER BY avg_s DESC
